prose: Jason Quitt returns to InnerVerse to discuss his new book, Gates of the Annunaki: Sacred Geometry Keys to the Gods. We explore the connections between depth psychology & "ancient alien gods," syncretism between ancient Sumerian and other mythologies, the Seven Sages or Kings that created civilization, universal deluge stories and buried ruins, the geometry of the solar savior, and biological measurements in pyramids and artifacts.
ext: Jason tells the stories of Gilgamesh and the descent of Inanna, along with parallels to Genesis, the mystical significance of 72, the hidden symbolism of the crescent moon shape, divination philosophy, astrotheological encoding of Sumerian artifacts, and just what makes an artifact "sacred."
